description: Use this when an authenticated user explicitly asks to publish a property on PropFácil. This creates a private draft that goes public only after the user reviews and activates it on PropFácil at the returned confirmUrl. Safe to retry with the same idempotencyKey.

bathrooms.description: Number of bathrooms, including fractional half-bath values when applicable.

bedrooms.description: Number of bedrooms; use zero only when the property has none.

city.description: Mexican city or municipality where the property is located.

currency.description: Currency used for the advertised price.

description.description: Public, accurate description of the property.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable unique key for this publish request; reuse it when retrying.

isCommercial.description: True for commercial real estate; false for residential real estate.

latitude.description: WGS84 latitude for the property location.

longitude.description: WGS84 longitude for the property location.

price.description: Positive advertised price in the selected currency.

state.description: Mexican state where the property is located, when known.

title.description: Public listing title shown to prospective buyers or tenants.

transactionType.description: Whether the property is offered for sale or lease.

name: publish_property

confirmUrl.description: Private page where the user reviews and activates the draft.

title: Publish a property
